title: BITCOIN WARNING: THIS COULD TRAP TRADERS (Prepare Now)!!! - Bitcoin News Today, Ethereum & Altcoins

Dominance is pushing into 60.5-61% resistance; a breakout above ~61-61.5% would crush altcoins.
BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and LINK all play out daily bearish divergences, so expect weakness lacking bullish momentum for 1-2 weeks.
